title: 信用卡余额增速放缓：美联储按兵不动，消费者能否继续吸收高油价？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Sentiment is one thing, how consumers actually act is another thing, just some of the earnings this morning, UPS solid, maybe some issues around the margin, Coca-Cola, people are still
segments.zh: 情绪是一回事，消费者实际行为是另一回事。今早财报中，UPS表现稳健，但利润率可能有些问题；可口可乐，人们仍在购买饮料。

segments.en: buying drinks. What is your read as we start this earnings season on the consumer?
segments.zh: 在财报季开启之际，您如何看待消费者？

segments.en: Well, I think the Fed only needs to look at its own data, which is I look at weekly credit card balances and weekly credit card balances show the consumer absorbing higher gas prices
segments.zh: 我认为美联储只需看自己的数据，即每周信用卡余额，这些数据显示消费者正在消化更高的油价。

segments.en: and actually inflation peaking in mid-April, even though gas prices peaked in mid-May.
segments.zh: 实际上通胀在四月中旬见顶，尽管油价在五月中旬才见顶。

segments.en: So you've seen prices decelerate from May's time, and even though there's been basically almost a dollar increase in gas prices over the last month, credit card balances, which are
segments.zh: 因此，自五月以来价格已减速，尽管过去一个月油价上涨了近一美元，但信用卡余额（非循环余额，而是基于支出的余额）继续减速。

segments.en: not people revolving balances, these are balances based on spending, and those have come, those are continued to decelerate, so they're up, but they're not up as much.
segments.zh: 这些余额仍在上升，但增幅减小。

segments.en: So I think if the Fed, and this is Fed, not New York Fed, Fed data, is going to give them a lot of reason to stay on hold.
segments.zh: 因此，如果美联储（不是纽约联储，而是美联储数据）参考这些数据，将有充分理由维持利率不变。

segments.en: I think this week, Stan Holder allowed the wiggle room to maybe even hike.
segments.zh: 本周，斯坦·霍尔德留出了可能加息的空间。

segments.en: I think they stand hold, and they'll probably still have this tough guy language with this hawkish language that gives them wiggle room.
segments.zh: 我认为他们会按兵不动，但可能仍会使用强硬措辞，保留政策空间。

segments.en: So I think that putting these people on these special task force buys German war's time,
segments.zh: 因此，我认为将这些人员纳入特别工作组为德国争取了时间。

segments.en: right? I think that was one of the issues, right?
segments.zh: 对吧？我认为那是问题之一，对吧？
